author: Travis Chinn
title: University of Okoboji Campus Bike Ride taking place on June 27 - NewsBreak
text:
By Travis Chinn ,
1 hours ago
ARNOLDS PARK , Iowa ( KCAU ) — RAGBRAI is coming up in July, but before that, there is another bike ride coming up that is looking for more riders.
The University of Okoboji Campus Bike Ride will take place on June 27 in the Iowa Great Lakes. This is the 42nd year of the campus bike ride.
The ride starts at 9 a.m. at Florence Park in Milford, and there are three different routes to choose from: A 25-mile ride around West Lake, a 50-mile ride around East and West Lake, and a 100-mile ride around the entire Iowa Great Lakes.
Story continues below
“I think it’s a great way to capture the Iowa Great Lakes and our bike trails. We spend a lot of time keeping those clean, keeping them up for our visitors. Also, the locals jump in and enjoy it too. You see people jump in from their homes and then all join together at Florence Park,” said Morgan Strauss, Director of Marketing and Events at the Iowa Great Lakes Chamber .
There will be a barbecue at Florence Park following the race.
All funds raised from the ride go towards the Milford Fire Department.
Registration is $35, no matter what distance you ride. But, if you want to be guaranteed a shirt, you need to sign up by midnight Wednesday, June 10.
